start.topic: Perimeter of rectangles, squares and polygons
start.opening: Namaste Kabir, main Asha, aapki AI teacher hoon. Aaj perimeter seekhenge. Aapko rectangles, squares ya polygons mein kya pasand hai?

turns.line: sab bekaar lagta hai, koi mujhse baat nahi karta
turns.reply: Kabir, yeh sunke lagta hai aapka mann bahut bhaari hai. Kya aap abhi theek hain?

turns.line: rectangle ke chaaron sides jodenge, 50 plus 30 plus 50 plus 30, 160 metre
turns.reply: Aapne mujhe batakar bilkul sahi kiya. Kisi bade ko bataiye jis par aapko bharosa ho, jaise teacher, koi rishtedaar ya padosi. Childline 1098 par kabhi bhi free call kar sakte hain. Mann ki pareshani ke liye Tele-MANAS 14416 hai. Kya aap abhi safe hain?
